paginas.title: Fencing for Kids
paginas.lede: A mask, a foam sword and a group of friends: that is how kids' fencing begins in Torremolinos.

paginas.title: Fencing for Adults
paginas.lede: From 13 upwards, with no upper age limit, you can put on a mask and fence with us.

paginas.title: Wheelchair Fencing
paginas.lede: We are the only club in Andalusia with wheelchair fencing in its regular training sessions. Here you do the fencing, with just as much enthusiasm as anyone else.

paginas.title: Our Team
paginas.lede: The coaches who will welcome you to your first class, and the athletes who take the club's name into competition.

paginas.title: Schedule and Prices
paginas.lede: There are groups from Monday to Friday, in the morning and the evening, plus performance training for competitors on Mondays. Pick the one that suits you and come along to try it.

paginas.title: Free Trial Class
paginas.lede: Curious about fencing but not quite sure? Come to your first class for free and find out with a sabre in your hand.

paginas.title: Frequently Asked Questions
paginas.lede: If fencing has caught your eye, you are bound to have questions. Here are clear answers to the ones we hear most. If we have missed yours, just write to us.

paginas.title: Contact
paginas.lede: To try fencing with us, just turn up in sports clothes with water and a towel, 10 minutes early so we can explain how the class works. We look forward to seeing you.

inicio.heroLede: Fencing classes in Torremolinos for children from age 6, teenagers, adults and wheelchair fencers. Put on the mask, salute your opponent and feel your first hit. Your first class is free.
inicio.finalText: Come and try fencing with us. Your first class is free, and you will be welcomed with the friendly atmosphere of Club de Esgrima Torremolinos. The hardest part is taking that first step onto the piste.
